cover_highlight: A milestone week — Memorial Day weekend opens with rain and a pulled-pork BBQ at Beth and Matt's, the kids host a sleepover gimbap-and-grandma-pizza night Monday, and a sunny Thursday brings the keys to the new house. The week closes Saturday with celebration pizza in the new kitchen and Jungle's Volcano on the speakers.

days.name: Sun 05/24
days.weather_detail: Cloudy (0% sunshine), wind 6 mph with gusts up to 18 mph, 74% precip, 0.44" rain
time_constraints: Hosted dinner — bring an offering, not cooking at home.
days.dinner: BBQ at Beth and Matt's — Pulled Pork and Burgers
days.dinner_description: A hosted Memorial Day weekend BBQ at Beth and Matt's. Pulled pork and burgers are the headliners. We bring a thoughtful side or finishing sauce so the family arrives with something special in hand and a quiet thank-you to the host.
dinner_key_ingredients: our contribution: apple-fennel slaw or finishing sauce
days.dinner_notes: Bring an elevated slaw or finishing sauce. Indoor/covered setup likely given the rain.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Heavy on pork and beef; aim for a lighter vegetable-forward lunch.
days.activity_notes: Moderate rain through the afternoon — pack a change of clothes for Elsie and an indoor-friendly toy.
prep_notes: Make the slaw or sauce Saturday night so flavors meld.
Defrost dinner protein for Monday's grandma pizza.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Rainy Sunday hosted dinner calls for warm, smoky soul that fills the kitchen on the drive home, not the BBQ itself.

days.name: Mon 05/25
days.weather_detail: Cloudy (0% sunshine), wind 4 mph with gusts up to 15 mph, 48% precip
days.calendar: Memorial Day · Sleepover with Isla & Evyln
time_constraints: Two-track dinner — kids' gimbap night plus an adult grandma pizza.
days.dinner_description: Two parallel dinners running on the same night. The girls — Elsie, Isla, and Evyln — get an interactive gimbap rolling station with seasoned rice, julienned carrots and cucumber, spinach, egg ribbons, and bulgogi or canned tuna. The adults eat Dan's grandma pizza: a thick, square Sicilian-style pie with crushed San Marzano tomatoes, low-moisture mozzarella, and basil added at the end.
days.dinner_notes: Gimbap is hands-on for the kids — set up a rolling station with mats. Pizza dough should rise on the counter through the afternoon.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Gimbap gives the kids fiber, iron from beef, and color. Pizza is a refined-carb evening — balance with greens at lunch.
days.activity_notes: Indoor games, gimbap-rolling competition, family movie. Read Chelsie's Memorial Day story before bed.
prep_notes: Mix pizza dough Monday morning so it has 8 hours to rise.
Cook short-grain rice and cool with rice vinegar before kids arrive.
Julienne carrots and cucumber; blanch spinach.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Three little girls together for a sleepover on a family-themed holiday — Sister Sledge writes the obvious soundtrack and gives the adults something joyful to cook the grandma pizza to.

days.name: Tue 05/26
days.weather_detail: Cloudy (5% sunshine), wind 6 mph with gusts up to 10 mph, 15% precip
calendar_items: Work block 2:30 PM - 5:00 PM (1:1s + MBR Sync)
time_constraints: Dinner after swim — Babo Pasta can be largely prepped ahead.
days.dinner: Babo Pasta — Egg-Yolk Spinach Tagliatelle with Brown Butter and Parm
days.dinner_description: The family favorite. Homemade egg-yolk and spinach tagliatelle, dressed in nutty brown butter, finished with finely grated Parmigiano-Reggiano and torn sage. It's a recipe that earns its weekly spot because every member of the household actually asks for it.
days.dinner_notes: Make the dough in the morning so it rests. Cut tagliatelle right before swim, cook on return.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Spinach in the pasta delivers folate and a bit of iron. Add a side salad for fiber and vitamin C.
days.activity_notes: Pack swim bag in the morning; warm towel and snack in the car for the ride home.
prep_notes: Make pasta dough during work-from-home morning block.
Brown butter just before serving so the milk solids stay golden, not burnt.
days.album_pairing_rationale: A favorite pasta deserves a favorite kind of groove. Talking Heads keep the kitchen alert and the cooking rhythmic — perfect for rolling out dough between tasks.

days.name: Wed 05/27
days.weather_detail: Cloudy (40% sunshine), wind 8 mph with gusts up to 22 mph, 50% precip, 0.93" rain
calendar_items: House final walkthrough 5:30 PM at 2515 Fowlers Ln
Elsie's first night of swim team 7:00 PM at Hunters Woods Pool
days.calendar: No School · Walkthrough 5:30 · First swim team 7:00
time_constraints: Tight window between 5:30 walkthrough and 7:00 swim team — dinner must be on the table by 6:30, eaten in 20 minutes.
Quickest meal of the week by design.
days.dinner_description: The fastest meal of the week — sharp cheddar grilled cheese with mayo-on-the-outside crust, alongside a quick tomato soup built from a can of San Marzanos, sautéed garlic, butter, a splash of cream, and basil. Twenty minutes door to dinner.
days.dinner_notes: Mayo on the outside of the bread for an even golden crust. Soup can be made the night before.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Heavy on dairy and refined carbs. A side of cucumber sticks or apple slices balances the plate.
days.activity: Final house walkthrough · First night of swim team
days.activity_notes: Big day — Elsie's first swim team practice. Bring a celebration treat for the car ride home.
prep_notes: Make tomato soup Tuesday night so Wednesday is just reheat + grill the sandwiches.
Slice cheese and bread before the walkthrough.
days.album_pairing_rationale: A light, breezy electropop record matches the speed and brightness of a 20-minute grilled cheese — and gives Elsie a pleasant soundtrack for swim-team excitement.

days.name: Thu 05/28
days.weather_detail: Sunny (96% sunshine), wind 13 mph with gusts up to 27 mph, 24% precip
calendar_items: House closing 1:45 PM - 3:30 PM at 2503 Fowlers Ln
Swim practice 7:00 PM at Hunters Woods Pool
time_constraints: Plan for the emotional weight of closing day — keep dinner familiar and warm.
days.dinner: Pork Chops with Couscous, Carrots, and Peas
days.dinner_description: Bone-in pork chops seared and finished with a lemon-Dijon pan sauce, served over fluffy couscous studded with sweet peas and caramelized carrot coins. A celebration plate that doesn't take itself too seriously on a day that does.
days.dinner_notes: Salt the chops in the morning. Sear hot, finish gentle. Couscous takes 5 minutes off the heat.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Pork gives B12 and zinc; peas and carrots add fiber, vitamin A, vitamin C. A solid closing-day plate.
days.activity_notes: Take a photo at the closing table. Toast the new house at dinner — sparkling cider for Elsie.
prep_notes: Dry-brine the pork chops in the morning.
Caramelize carrots Wednesday night for a head start.
days.album: Janelle Monáe – The Age of Pleasure
days.album_pairing_rationale: A celebratory record about arrival, joy, and finally being where you want to be. The right music for closing day.

days.name: Fri 05/29
days.weather_detail: Sunny (96% sunshine), wind 8 mph with gusts up to 24 mph, 1% precip
calendar_items: Laura drops car off to a friend in DC (afternoon)
YAT 4:30 PM - 6:00 PM at 2310 Colts Neck Rd
Swim practice 7:00 PM at Hunters Woods Pool
time_constraints: Breakfast-for-dinner because everyone is moving fast — pancakes are fast to plate and easy to keep warm.
days.dinner: Buttermilk Pancakes with Sausage and Egg-in-the-Center
days.dinner_description: Tall, fluffy buttermilk pancakes, browned breakfast sausage links, and the centerpiece move: a pancake with a sunny egg cooked right into the middle — like an egg-in-a-hole but griddled in batter. Maple syrup, butter, and cold berries on the side.
days.dinner_notes: Rest the batter 10 minutes. Cook eggs into the center on lower heat so the white sets while the bottom of the pancake browns.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Refined carbs + saturated fat heavy. Lean on cold berries for fiber and vitamin C; a lunch-time salad helps.
days.activity_notes: Long day for the adults — pancakes-for-dinner is the gift the night deserves.
prep_notes: Whisk dry ingredients Thursday night to speed the morning-of build.
Pull sausage from the freezer Thursday.
days.album_pairing_rationale: A glamorous, danceable record that turns pancakes-for-dinner into a small Friday night celebration — disco shimmer to match the breakfast-as-treat vibe.

days.name: Sat 05/30
days.weather_detail: Sunny (95% sunshine), wind 13 mph with gusts up to 26 mph, 7% precip
calendar_items: YAT 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM at 2310 Colts Neck Rd (tentative)
time_constraints: Make the pizza special — this is the new-house dinner.
days.dinner: Celebration Pizza for the New House
days.dinner_description: Two or three pies cooked as hot as the oven allows, with a high-hydration dough rested overnight. One classic margherita with torn buffalo mozzarella and basil; one with crisp pepperoni cupping pools of grease; and a celebration pie with prosciutto, arugula, hot honey, and a final drift of burrata for the new-house toast.
days.dinner_notes: Cold-ferment the dough 48 hours starting Thursday for maximum flavor.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Pizza night — pair with a vinegar-heavy arugula salad to cut the richness.
days.activity_notes: First Saturday in the new house. Cue Jungle's Volcano, open a good bottle, let Elsie pick a pie shape.
prep_notes: Start dough Thursday night for a 48-hour cold ferment.
Pull dough out 2 hours before stretch.
days.album_pairing_rationale: A dance-floor-bright record for the literal celebration dinner of the week. Volcano is the right kind of loud for a first night in a new house.

appetizers.name: Whipped Ricotta with Hot Honey and Lemon Zest
appetizers.description: Whole-milk ricotta whipped smooth with olive oil and salt, finished with hot honey, lemon zest, and cracked black pepper. Served with grilled bread.

appetizers.name: Marinated Olives with Orange Peel and Fennel Seed
appetizers.description: Castelvetrano and Kalamata olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, fennel seed, and a smashed garlic clove.

salads.name: Arugula with Lemon, Parm, and Olive Oil
salads.description: The pizza-night classic — peppery arugula tossed simply with lemon, fruity olive oil, and shaved Parmigiano.
salads.dressing: Lemon juice + olive oil + salt, dressed at the table
salads.flavor_rationale: Cuts pizza richness on Saturday and pancake sweetness on Friday.

salads.name: Apple-Fennel Slaw with Cider Vinegar
salads.description: Thinly shaved fennel, tart apple, scallion, and parsley with a cider vinegar dressing.
salads.dressing: Cider vinegar, Dijon, olive oil, honey
salads.flavor_rationale: The offering for Sunday's BBQ — cuts the pulled pork and burgers.

salads.name: Cucumber and Tomato Salad with Feta
salads.description: Crisp Persian cucumbers, halved cherry tomatoes, crumbled feta, red wine vinegar, and oregano.
salads.dressing: Red wine vinegar + olive oil + oregano
salads.flavor_rationale: Fresh vegetable side that fits Tuesday's pasta and Thursday's pork chops.

salads.name: Spring Greens with Strawberries and Almonds
salads.description: Spring mix, sliced strawberries, toasted almonds, and shaved manchego with a champagne vinaigrette.
salads.flavor_rationale: A celebration-week salad — pairs with Thursday's closing-day dinner.

beverages.name: Lambrusco (chilled)
beverages.description: A lightly sparkling, slightly chilled red — the right wine for pizza night and Tuesday's pasta.
beverages.why: Acidic, refreshing, and red enough for tomato sauce and Parmigiano.

beverages.name: Sparkling Cider (for Elsie)
beverages.description: Apple sparkling cider in a wine glass for Thursday's closing toast and Saturday's new-house celebration.
beverages.why: Elsie gets a real toast on the two biggest days of the week.

beverages.name: Espresso Martini
beverages.description: A Friday-night-after-pancakes adult treat, or a Saturday post-pizza pour. Espresso, vodka, coffee liqueur, simple syrup, shaken hard.
beverages.why: A celebration drink with enough caffeine to extend the new-house Saturday night.

prep_ahead: Saturday night: make Sunday's apple-fennel slaw or BBQ sauce.
Monday morning: mix grandma pizza dough and let rise 8 hours; cook short-grain rice for gimbap.
Tuesday morning: make Babo pasta dough; let rest in fridge.
Tuesday night: make tomato soup for Wednesday's grilled cheese.
Thursday morning: dry-brine pork chops; start Saturday pizza dough for a 48-hour cold ferment.
Thursday night: whisk dry pancake ingredients for Friday.
Friday afternoon: pull pizza dough from fridge 2 hours before Saturday's stretch.
notes: Two major family milestones this week — the house closing Thursday and the new house celebration Saturday. Plan ahead so cooking doesn't compete with the emotional weight of those days.
Monday's gimbap-and-grandma-pizza is one of the most fun nights of the week. Set up the gimbap station like a craft project for Elsie, Isla, and Evyln.
Elsie's only restriction this week: no onions and mushrooms mixed together. None of this week's planned dinners trigger that combination, so no day-level Elsie note is required.
Memorial Day is Monday — Chelsie's bedtime story this week is a Memorial Day reflection with neighbors Eric, Ed, and Dale. Read it Sunday or Monday night.
